t: GripIt Plasterboard Fixings offer a robust solution for securely mounting items onto plasterboard walls. These innovative fixings feature expanding wings that create a vice-like grip, distributing weight effectively and preventing damage to the plasterboard. They are ideal for trade professionals installing shelves, mirrors, curtain rails, and blinds in residential or commercial properties. Constructed from durable acetal plastic, these 15mm fixings provide a high maximum load capacity of 71kg, ensuring reliable support for various installations. The design eliminates the need for additional noggings or stud wall modifications, streamlining the installation process. Each pack includes 25 yellow fixings and 4 x 25mm screws, suitable for plasterboard thicknesses between 9.5mm and 15mm. They are also removable and reusable, offering flexibility for future adjustments.
